title: Keto challenge
intro:
Everything you wanted to know about keto, in one place.
Easy, simple, accessible (also on your budget).
At your own pace and time, without the confusion.

plans.name: Going Keto - 4 weeks
plans.alt: Fried eggs with kale and pecans

programLead: A ketogenic diet transition plan that suits (very) busy women
method: A gradual, delicious method that is actually possible to stick with
For the superwoman who juggles work, family, classes, travel, vacations, restaurants, weekends, hosting... Or in short - life.
Without extremes. Without turning your life upside down. Simply a way that fits into your routine.
expectTitle: What to expect during and at the end of the program:
expect: Freedom from addictions (sugar, processed food and carbohydrates) and mental liberation from emotional dependence on food.
Fewer inches and a feeling of lightness in the body.
Feeling alert, a sharp mind, stable mood and patience.
Improvement in health indicators and relief from symptoms such as: migraines, allergies, skin problems, stomach pain and digestive problems, premenstrual symptoms and more.
how: Clear and simple daily instructions to implement, that fit a busy lifestyle and a real schedule.
registerText: Leave your details and I’ll get back to you to set things up and explain the payment. You can start with the free 3-day plan and decide later.
